title: Netherlands to Germany
intro: The morning begins in Emmen with a visit to the Netherlands branch office before The Long Way Around continues southeast into Germany. The day finishes in Frankfurt, which becomes the base for the next few days.

stops.name: Emmen
stops.description: Begin the day in Emmen in the northeastern Netherlands.

stops.name: Netherlands Bethel
stops.description: Visit the Netherlands Bethel Branch office in Emmen.

stops.name: Frankfurt
stops.description: Cross into Germany and settle in for the next part of the journey in Frankfurt.
